decision_algebra: ANY DENY > ANY INDETERMINATE > ALL PASS

theorem.statement: A TPM object Name is coherent with a captured public area only when the exact TPMT_PUBLIC bytes, their nameAlg, the TPM-provided Name, and the ReadPublic provenance all agree.
theorem.format_rule: For TPM2B_PUBLIC input the outer two-byte size field is excluded from the Name hash; for TPMT_PUBLIC input the bytes are hashed as supplied.
theorem.scope: v0.1 supports SHA-256 object Names and explicit TPMT_PUBLIC or TPM2B_PUBLIC input format.

required_input.public_wire_sha256: SHA-256 of the supplied wire bytes
required_input.readpublic_source_sha256: digest of the exact capture/source receipt

future_live_capture_requirements: execute tpm2_readpublic against the TPM object
capture TPMT_PUBLIC with tpm2_readpublic -f tpmt -o <file> and the TPM-provided Name with -n <file> and Qualified Name with -q <file>
hash exactly the TPMT_PUBLIC bytes and compare the resulting Name to the TPM-provided Name
record the source command, exact tool version, public-area digest, Name digest, and Qualified Name digest in the same capture session
compose the resulting public-name coherence claim into AK/EK lineage before any Quote or creation certificate is accepted
